title: Desk bridge v0: perm
description: Permissions: request, query and revoke grants, the prompter's side of a request, and the approval an agent's irreversible call waits for. Asking and looking at one's own grants need no scope; the person decides. Seeing other callers' grants, granting them for the person (perm.grant) and answering prompts and approvals need perm:manage.

PermRequestRequest.description: Ask the person for a permission. Resolves when they answer.

reason.description: Why the caller asks, shown to the person in the prompt. Optional; a prompt without one says that none was given.

GrantDuration.description: How long a grant lasts. once: the next call it allows, then it expires. session: until Desk quits. always: kept on disk across restarts. Every grant lasts until revoked at the latest. perm.request defaults to session.

PermRequestResult.description: Result of perm.request. A refusal is a result, not an error. A request that a lasting grant (session or always) already covers is granted at once with that grant, unless the caller is an agent and the grant lies outside its allowlist.

RefusalReason.description: Why perm.request was refused without asking the person. refused-earlier: the person refused this caller this permission and scope earlier in the session; it holds until the caller is granted a permission that covers it. outside-allowlist: the caller is an agent (agent:<id>) and no permission in agents.<id>.allow of init.yaml covers the request; an agent is never granted anything outside a non-empty allowlist (ADR 0072). Absent from a result means the person (or the core's own prompter) refused this request.

PermQueryParams.description: Parameters of perm.query. With permission, only grants that cover it are returned.

PermRevokeRequest.description: Give a grant back. The person can also revoke any grant at any time.

PermRevokeParams.description: Parameters of perm.revoke. Without scope only the caller's own grants; with perm:manage any caller's.

PermGrantRequest.description: Grant another caller a permission for the person, without a prompt, when an act of theirs already answers it: opening a file they chose gives the plugin that opens it read access to the file's folder (ADR 0131).

PermGrantParams.description: Parameters of perm.grant. Needs perm:manage. A lasting grant of the caller's (session or always) that already covers the permission is answered as it is, without a new one. An agent (agent:<id>) is never granted anything outside its allowlist: that is permission_denied.

caller.description: Who gets the grant: a plugin id, or agent:<id>.

reason.description: What the person did that answers it, such as the file they opened.

PermGrantResult.description: Result of perm.grant: the grant the caller now holds, new or one it held already.

Grant.description: A permission the person granted to the caller.

expiresAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp; absent means for as long as the duration allows.

PermListRequest.description: List every caller's grants, for the person's permissions view.

PermListParams.description: Parameters of perm.list. With caller, only that caller's grants are returned.

PermListResult.description: Result of perm.list, oldest grant first.

CallerGrant.description: A grant together with the caller that holds it.

PermAnswerRequest.description: The prompter answers a perm.prompt with the person's decision.

PermAnswerParams.description: Parameters of perm.answer. duration is what the person chose; absent keeps the one asked for.

parent.description: true grants the prompt's parent offer instead of the permission asked. Ignored when granted is false; invalid_params on a prompt that offers no parent.

PermPromptEvent.description: A caller asked for a permission and the person has to decide. Sent to callers that hold perm:manage. An agent's caller is agent:<id>; it asks only within its allowlist.

PermPromptData.description: Payload of perm.prompt: who asks, for what, why and for how long.

reason.description: The caller's reason, to show as it is. Absent when the caller gave none.

parent.description: The parent folder the person may grant instead: the same permission over the folder that holds the one asked for, offered when this caller asks for a third folder under it in the session. Never a root, the home folder or a folder holding it, nor a scope the person refused this caller earlier, nor, for an agent, a scope outside its allowlist.

PermApprovalEvent.description: An agent's irreversible call waits for the person's approval, even when a grant covers it (ADR 0078): an fs.write or a net.fetch whose target no always grant of the agent allows, a proc.spawn, or a cmd.invoke of a command its provider's manifest marks irreversible. Sent to callers that hold perm:manage; the first perm.approve decides. A caller that is not an agent is never held.

PermApprovalData.description: Payload of perm.approval: which agent, what it is about to do, to what, and what it would change.

permission.description: The scope the call carries, which a grant of the agent's covers.

target.description: What the call touches: the path for fs.write, the command for proc.spawn, the URL for net.fetch, the command id for cmd.invoke, the fact for memory.remember, the app (name and bundle id, or the screen) for computer.*.

size.description: fs.write: the bytes it would write.

task.description: The task the call belongs to: the desk's brain turn (brain.turn's turnId) whose tool call it is. Present only when there is one; only then may perm.approve answer task.

ApprovalAction.description: The bridge method an agent's irreversible call is. memory.remember is an agent keeping a fact in the person's memory: its target is the fact (ADR 0096). computer.* is an agent's act on the computer: its target is the app it goes to (ADR 0123).

ApprovalPreview.description: What the call would do, as text. diff: a unified diff of the file as it is against what the write puts there (a new file is all additions), when both are UTF-8 text and the file is at most 1 MiB; the first 200 changed lines. command: the command line, quoted for a POSIX shell. url: the method and the URL. args: the command's args as JSON. fact: the fact memory.remember would keep. input: the act on the computer in words, such as click left at (120, 340). truncated says that the text was cut.

ApprovalPreviewKind.description: What a preview's text is: a unified diff, a command line, a method and URL, a command's args as JSON, a fact to remember in the person's words, or an act on the computer in words (input).

PermApproveRequest.description: The prompter answers a perm.approval with the person's decision.

ApprovalAnswer.description: once: this call runs. task: this call runs, and so do the agent's later calls of the same action whose target the approved scope covers, until the task ends (invalid_params on an approval without a task). deny: this call is refused with permission_denied; the next one asks again.

PermApprovalDoneEvent.description: An approved call ran: what came of it. Sent to callers that hold perm:manage.

undoable.description: true when cmd.undo can take the write back (#276). Absent while the core does not serve cmd.undo.

PermChangedEvent.description: One of the caller's grants changed.
